preconditions.description: The input is a natural number N representing the number of attractions, where 3 ≤ N ≤ 20.

postconditions.expression: all(len(row) == N for row in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: The output consists of exactly N rows, each containing N space-separated integers.

postconditions.expression: all(row[i] == 0 for row in stdout.splitlines() for i in range(N))
postconditions.description: The diagonal elements of the adjacency matrix are all zero.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(stdout.splitlines()[i][j].strip()) <= 1000 for i in range(N) for j in range(N) if i != j)
postconditions.description: All off-diagonal elements are positive integers between 1 and 1000 (inclusive).

postconditions.expression: len({int(stdout.splitlines()[i][j].strip()) for i in range(N) for j in range(N) if i != j}) == N * (N - 1) // 2
postconditions.description: All off-diagonal elements are pairwise distinct.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(int(stdout.splitlines()[i][j].strip()) for j in range(N) if j != i) == sum(int(stdout.splitlines()[i][k].strip()) for k in range(N) if k != i) for i in range(1, N))
postconditions.description: For every pair of distinct attractions i and k, the sum of the edge weights in any Hamiltonian cycle is the same (i.e., the graph is a constant Hamiltonian cycle sum graph).
